subject.title: Discord plugin: channels added to channels.discord.guilds.*.channels.* post-startup are never subscribed (requires full gateway restart)

question: Should maintainers require live or focused Discord add-channel proof before repair, or sponsor a fix from the v2026.6.1 deployment report plus the source-level stale-snapshot risk?
rationale: Current main has an intended broad `channels.discord` restart path, but the reporter gives a plausible real deployment failure and there is no test proving the exact post-startup add-channel inbound path.

options.title: Require focused proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open in needs-info/maintainer-review until a live Discord run or focused integration harness shows current main still drops inbound messages from a newly added guild channel.

options.title: Sponsor reload-path repair now
options.body: Let a maintainer choose a concrete repair around the existing reload-to-provider-restart path despite the missing live proof, with regression coverage for the add-channel flow.

options.title: Fold into broader dynamic-channel direction
options.body: Treat this as part of a broader dynamic Discord channel allowlist or reload-granularity product decision, accepting a larger authorization and compatibility review surface.

recommendation.title: Require focused proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open in needs-info/maintainer-review until a live Discord run or focused integration harness shows current main still drops inbound messages from a newly added guild channel.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on Discord provider and allowlist ownership, while the proof question depends on that startup snapshot and inbound admission behavior.
